name: TeleMasters Holdings Limited
source: Audited consolidated annual financial statements FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026), TeleMasters Holdings Limited, audited by Nexia SAB and T with an unmodified opinion; figures in rand as presented. Operating Expenses combine other operating expenses and the movement in credit loss allowances, net of other operating income. Net Profit is the amount attributable to owners of the parent (2,648,073); total profit for the year including non-controlling interests is 2,525,780. FY2025 column replaced with the audited comparative, which also includes 233,000 of discontinued operations in net profit.
